request.subject: September 2026 seizure of twelve AI-generated deepfake website domains
request.summary: Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I request records sufficient to identify the twelve domain names that the New York County District Attorney's Office announced it seized on September 14, 2026 in connection with websites allegedly disseminating, publishing, or selling AI-generated nonconsensual intimate imagery. I also request, to the extent publicly releasable: (1) the seizure-warrant number or numbers associated with those twelve domains; (2) the warrant return or returns, inventories, schedules, attachments, or other records identifying the seized domains; (3) any public-facing seizure orders or records sufficient to identify the exact domains seized; (4) records sufficient to identify the registries and registrars directed to implement the seizures, excluding confidential investigative details where applicable; and (5) the date on which each seizure order or warrant was executed. I am expressly not requesting victim names, victim images or videos, sexually explicit material, confidential witness information, grand-jury material, sealed affidavits, personal identifying information of victims, or material whose release would expose victims to further harm. If any responsive record contains exempt material, please provide all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions. If the Office determines that the full warrant, return, attachment, or inventory cannot be released, please provide records sufficient to identify the domain names and warrant/docket identifiers to the extent disclosure is lawful. Electronic production is preferred.
request.requested_action: Produce responsive records electronically, including segregable non-exempt portions.
